item.title: Federal Tax Changes Might Cost Nonprofits $5.69B - The NonProfit Times
item.description: Future charitable giving in the United States might be reduced by $5.69 billion or roughly 1% of all U.S. giving under tax provisions included in last year’s One Big Beautiful Bill (OBBB) law when compared to previous tax law. item.title: Strong Collective Giving Efforts Need Structure - The NonProfit Times
item.description: (image from (https://johnsoncenter.org) Strength in collective giving efforts such as giving circles, identity-based groups or cause-focused entities stems from structures. item.title: Data Shows Widening Split Between Large And Small NPOs - The NonProfit Times
item.description: New revenue data for 2025 shows a stark difference in the performance of large nonprofits versus small organizations when it comes to fundraising, a split that has become more evident during the past two years. Large organizations finished the year with approximately 11.7% revenue growth year-over-year while medium-sized organizations had modest growth of approximately 2%. Small organizations […]
